main_text.l: Mosaicis illos ritibus initiarunt; attamen
eum ab Idololatris essent orti. Hebraicas
ceremonias nunquam perfecte arripue-
runt, sed aliquid semper antiquae
gentili-tatis retinuerunt; & praesertim colum-
bae, sub cujus figura ab Assyriis Semira-
mis, ni fallor, colebatur, nescio quid
honoris aut cultus exhibebant: unde à Ju-
daeis omni tempore, usque ab aevo Serva-
toris nostri pro haereticis sunt habiti. Sa-
crarum autem scripturarum quod tunc
extabat, cum primum in Samariae regio-
nem sunt ingresi, ab initio receperunt,
Pentateuchum nempe, & nescio num
aliud aliquid: Prophetas vero, & alios
libros, qui postea prodierunt, cum tunc
temporis non extarent, nec hodie inter
sacros adnumerant. Contra oi [?] Qvaraim,
ni decipior, libros omnes sacros Hebraeo-
rum recipiunt: sed literalem tantum sen-
sum observant, nulla admissa interpreta-
tione neque traditione majorum; exem-
pli gratia eum dicatur in lege, Die S. b-
bati nihil esse operandum, neque lucer-
nas noctu incendendas, sed alii Hebraei

page.notes: The word "oi" after "Contra" is small italic type set inline and is marked [?]. The first letter of "Mosaicis" is partly worn. The paragraph continues from the previous page. The text is copied as printed, with printed hyphens kept at line ends. The right side of the scan shows show-through and the neighbouring page, which were left out.
